page_title: HAV 0-2 PSG | Le Havre v PSG 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Le Havre are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' 0 - 2 Goal! Vitinha (PSG) neatly controls a decent pass from Manuel Ugarte. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the top right corner from the edge of the box. 0:2.
87' Danilo Pereira (PSG) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) is coming onto the pitch as Arouna Sangante cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
85' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
85' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) takes the corner which is cleared.
83' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.

81' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
80' Yassine Kechta will be replaced by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).
79' Vitinha (PSG) sends a cross in and finds Randal Kolo Muani inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.

78' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Arnau Tenas, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
76' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
75' That's a well-taken pass by Nabil Alioui (Le Havre). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
75' Substitution. Carlos Soler will be replaced by Lucas Hernandez (PSG).
74' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Nordi Mukiele is replaced by Milan Skriniar (PSG).
74' That's the end of the game for Ousmane Dembele, who is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).
74' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
73' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:3.
73' The current number of shots on goal is 4:3.
71' Vitinha (PSG) attempts to feed Kylian Mbappe with a chip pass, but Arthur Desmas reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
69' Le Havre take a short corner kick.
68' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Josue Casimir will be replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
64' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) serves up a nice cross, but Arnau Tenas punches the ball away.
60' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
58' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Arnau Tenas.
57' Neat link-up play between Ousmane Dembele (PSG) and Kylian Mbappe, but Arthur Desmas reads the game well and the move breaks down.
56' The corner is swung in but Le Havre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
52' Le Havre take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Le Havre have a corner.

51' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Arnau Tenas. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
49' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
46' Substitution. Loic Nego is replaced by Nabil Alioui (Le Havre).
46' Half-time substitution. Luka Elsner decided to make a change. Abdoulaye Toure is replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
46' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
43' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Good chance for Josue Casimir (Le Havre) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the right post.
40' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just wide of the right post.
40' It seemed like Christopher Operi (Le Havre) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
40' Kang-In Lee (PSG) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
38' A cross into the box from Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is cleared.
37' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
36' The resulting corner from Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) comes to nothing.
36' Half-chance! Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) plays a pass into the box, but Arnau Tenas reacts well to snuff out the attack.
32' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Kylian Mbappe (PSG) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
30' Chance! Kylian Mbappe (PSG) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
29' Kang-In Lee (PSG) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

29' What a great touch by Kang-In Lee (PSG) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. The referee blows his whistle, PSG are awarded a corner kick.
27' Kylian Mbappe receives a sweet cross inside the box from Ousmane Dembele (PSG), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Ousmane Dembele slips it to Kylian Mbappe (PSG) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom right corner with a great effort. The score is 0:1.
22' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
22' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is penalised for holding. Bastien Dechepy signals a set piece.
21' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
20' Arthur Desmas pulls off a great save to deny Kylian Mbappe (PSG) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
20' Loic Nego (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
18' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.

17' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Le Havre are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
12' A substitution due to the red card. Bradley Barcola (PSG) walks off the pitch and is replaced by Arnau Tenas.
10' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) is shown a red card by the referee for a horror tackle that simply has no place in football!
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
8' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manuel Ugarte is coming onto the pitch as Fabian Ruiz (PSG) cannot continue after picking up an injury.

7' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
7' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

7' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The linesman points to the corner flag, Le Havre are going to take it.
6' Wonderful movement by Le Havre. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
5' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
4' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
3' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Le Havre will take the kick-off.
